title: BTS Open ARIRANG Latin American Leg with First-Ever Colombia Show at El Campín
detail: October 2, 2026 — BTS played their first concert in Colombia at Bogotá's El Campín, opening the Latin American leg of the ARIRANG World Tour. The 23-song set opened with 'Hooligan' and included 'Aliens', 'SWIM', 'FAKE LOVE', 'MIC Drop', 'IDOL' and 'Fire'. Reports put attendance at 35,000+ (El Tiempo) to 45,000 (Infobae); fans travelled from across Latin America, and V greeted the crowd in Colombian Spanish ('Bogotá, qué chimba'). The second show followed on Oct 3.

media.caption: Bogotá surrenders to BTS at El Campín.
